meta.title: Metro Atlanta Short-Term Rental (Airbnb / VRBO) Property Managers
meta.disclaimer: Independent directory. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or paid by any company listed. Fees and terms are taken from each company's public website as of the verification date and can change; always confirm in a written management agreement. Not legal, tax, or investment advice.
meta.last_refresh_note: 2026-11-09: added 4 managers verified against their own public pages — You Too Can Host (Atlanta, 20% + cleaning / 10% online-only), MasterHost (Atlanta page, 10%/15%/12% tiers), TruPorch Homes (25% full service, 60-day notice), and Cire Homes (from 15%, month-to-month). The original 6 rows keep their 2026-11-04 verification dates. Earlier: 2026-11-04 re-verification: all 6 managers re-checked against their live public pages. No headline fee changes. ATLStay: published email/address and 6-month guarantee added. Evolve: Risk-Free Guarantee and $249/yr mid-term add-on added. One Fine BnB: email and guest line added; 'no long-term contracts' no longer stated on pricing page, so field now says not stated. Stellar, PeachHaus, Awning: minor details added.

managers.name: ATLStay (Silverstone Management LLC)
managers.hq_city: Atlanta, GA (3343 Peachtree Rd NE, Atlanta, GA 30326, per pricing page)
managers.areas_served: Atlanta (Buckhead, Midtown, Inman Park, Old Fourth Ward, Virginia-Highland and more), Sandy Springs, Roswell, Alpharetta, Marietta, Smyrna, Brookhaven, Dunwoody, Johns Creek, Kennesaw, Duluth; also Savannah, Tybee Island, Blue Ridge, Helen, Athens, Lake Lanier, Augusta, Columbus
managers.management_fee: 10–15% of booking revenue, all-inclusive; exact rate quoted in writing per property
managers.setup_other_fees: No setup/onboarding fee; site lists no monthly minimum, cleaning markup, restocking, photography, or platform fees
managers.contract_minimums: No long-term contract; no early cancellation penalty; no minimum bookings or revenue; 6-month happiness guarantee on standard management agreement (per pricing page)
managers.notes: Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com distribution; also offers mid-term and long-term management (quoted separately). Pricing page says the first month's management fee applies only after the first guest checks in.

managers.name: Stellar Rentals Atlanta
managers.hq_city: Atlanta, GA (family-owned; Atlanta since 2017 per site)
managers.areas_served: Metro Atlanta: Midtown, Buckhead, Old Fourth Ward, Inman Park, Virginia-Highland, West Midtown, Grant Park, East Atlanta, Kirkwood, Decatur, Brookhaven, Sandy Springs, Dunwoody, Smyrna, Vinings, Marietta, Roswell, Alpharetta and more
managers.management_fee: 10–30% of booking revenue depending on service tier; site says most full-service owners pay 15–25%
managers.setup_other_fees: No monthly retainer (per Atlanta management page); setup fee not stated on page reviewed
managers.notes: Offers Airbnb co-hosting, VRBO management, corporate housing, and long-term leasing. Free compliance check for your address offered. Atlanta page says listing typically goes live 5–10 business days after walkthrough, with photography, pricing setup, and smart-lock installation included; owners keep their own Airbnb account.

managers.name: PeachHaus Group
managers.areas_served: Metro Atlanta incl. Atlanta, Marietta, Smyrna, Kennesaw, Alpharetta, Roswell, Woodstock, Lawrenceville, Duluth, Decatur
managers.management_fee: Short-term tiers: 12% Expert Online Management, 20% Premium, 25% Premium Plus. Separate hybrid/mid-term co-hosting program lists a 20% service fee
managers.setup_other_fees: “Low setup fees apply” — amount not published
managers.notes: Also manages mid-term (insurance/corporate housing) and long-term rentals; publishes Realtor and investor partner pages. Site says it has managed 100+ STR properties in Metro Atlanta.

managers.name: Awning
managers.areas_served: Atlanta, Georgia market page; national company
managers.management_fee: Atlanta page says full-service “starting at 10% of revenue”; the same page also shows “Starts at 15%” and “Starts at 5%” in other sections — confirm your rate in writing
managers.contract_minimums: No long-term contract; no cancellation penalties; 90-day notice to cancel
managers.notes: Atlanta page says Awning manages 20,000+ properties across all 50 states. Referral program paying $500–$2,000 per referred property (based on projected revenue) was seen on 2026-10-30; not re-checked 2026-11-04.

managers.name: Evolve
managers.areas_served: National; Atlanta-specific coverage not stated on the page reviewed — confirm
managers.management_fee: Core 10%, Plus 15%, Pro custom (2+ properties); fees apply after guests check in
managers.setup_other_fees: One-time $250 onboarding fee (+$25 per additional property). Cleaning and on-site care arranged and paid separately (your team or Evolve vetted partners)
managers.contract_minimums: No long-term commitments; Risk-Free Guarantee: if unsatisfied after the first six months, refund of management fees paid in that period (per FAQ). Plan changes take effect within 15 business days.
managers.notes: Hybrid model: Evolve handles listing, pricing, distribution, and guest communication; owner keeps local team / chooses a local Guest Contact. Damage protection $5k (Core) / $10k (Plus) plus $1M liability per site. New Mid-Term Rental Add-On (28+ night stays) listed at $249 per listing per year. Owner referral program (up to $400) seen 2026-10-30; not re-checked 2026-11-04.

managers.name: One Fine BnB
managers.areas_served: Atlanta (dedicated Atlanta page; references the City of Atlanta primary-residence-plus-one program)
managers.management_fee: Full Service from 20% of rental revenue; Partner Management (off-site) 10% (you keep your own cleaning and maintenance crew); BnBGenius software $10/month for any number of listings (AI voice concierge add-on $30/month)
managers.setup_other_fees: One-time $500 onboarding retainer for Full Service and Partner Management (photography, listing creation); no fixed charges after onboarding; fee charged on rental revenue only, not guest-paid cleaning fees, taxes, or deposits
managers.contract_minimums: Not stated on current pricing page (an earlier 2026-10-30 check noted 'no long-term contracts') — confirm in agreement
managers.notes: Managing short-term rentals since 2010 per site; lists properties across 25+ booking platforms and partner sites; Full Service includes a named manager.

managers.name: You Too Can Host
managers.hq_city: Atlanta, GA (based in Atlanta; serving Georgia since 2017 per site)
managers.areas_served: Full service (20% tier): Atlanta, Decatur, Brookhaven, Chamblee, Smyrna, Tucker, Stone Mountain, East Point, South Fulton; operates in Fulton, DeKalb, Douglas, Fayette, Gwinnett, Clayton, and Cobb counties and properties within a 1-hour drive of Midtown Atlanta. Online-only (10% tier) offered in all 50 states
managers.management_fee: 20% + the cleaning fee for full management (cleaning, inspections, restocking between stays); 10% for online-only management (listing, pricing, inquiries, guests; owner handles cleaning)
managers.setup_other_fees: Airbnb listing set-up $50 per listing; photography available for an additional fee (amount not published); additional sites such as VRBO listed at no charge for managed properties
managers.contract_minimums: Not published; FAQ says the listing is handed back to the owner with no fees if the owner decides to self-manage
managers.notes: Founded 2017; FAQ says it manages about 80 listings for about 60 owners. Lists on Airbnb, VRBO, and Zillow; also offers medium-term (30+ night) rentals. Guest response within 15 minutes 8am–10pm weekdays and 9am–7pm weekends; FAQ says there is no staffed overnight coverage. Fees paid via Airbnb's payout split. In-home consultation required before onboarding.

managers.name: MasterHost
managers.hq_city: Vancouver, BC, Canada (multi-market; Atlanta market page)
managers.areas_served: Metro Atlanta counties listed on its Atlanta page: Fulton, Gwinnett, Cobb, DeKalb, Clayton, Cherokee, Forsyth, Henry, Paulding, Coweta, Douglas, Fayette, Carroll, Newton, Bartow
managers.management_fee: Atlanta page lists Basic 10%, Premium 15%, and Full 12% per booking (which services are in each tier is shown only as a checklist graphic — confirm in writing)
managers.setup_other_fees: No onboarding or cancellation fees (per Atlanta page)
managers.contract_minimums: No fixed-term contracts; monthly agreements with 1-month cancellation
managers.notes: Atlanta page says MasterHost has served Metro Atlanta since 2015 and claims 300+ properties. Owners keep their own Airbnb accounts and are paid directly by the platform; MasterHost invoices monthly based on revenue collected. Services listed include key exchange, cleaning and laundry, maintenance, guest screening, multi-channel management, and licensing support.

managers.name: TruPorch Homes
managers.hq_city: Metro Atlanta, GA (TruPorch Homes, LLC; licensed Georgia real estate broker per site footer)
managers.areas_served: Metro Atlanta (site says homes outside metro Atlanta are declined)
managers.management_fee: 25% of gross booking revenue (full service); no management fee in a month with no bookings
managers.setup_other_fees: Onboarding, maintenance coordination, and project management fees are additional and set in the management agreement (amounts not published). In-house crew work billed at cost + 15% overhead + 15% profit. Guests pay cleaning fees; owners pay consumables and linens. Furnishing/design quoted per home
managers.contract_minimums: 60 days' written notice to cancel, either side
managers.notes: In-house cleaners and technicians (site says nothing is subcontracted); photographed inspection after every stay; handles City of Atlanta STR license and tax filings. Listing stays on the owner's account. Also manages long-term (10%), furnished mid-term (10%), and PadSplit/co-living homes per its pricing page.

managers.name: Cire Homes
managers.areas_served: Atlanta and surrounding metro areas (per FAQ); specific cities not listed
managers.management_fee: Full STR management starting at 15% of rental income (FAQ: of gross booking revenue)
managers.setup_other_fees: No upfront fees (per pricing page). Cleaning/turnover charged per stay (varies by size); handyman $75/hour plus supplies after a $250 monthly labor credit included for full-service clients; optional review dispute service $150 per successful dispute
managers.contract_minimums: Month-to-month contracts; FAQ says no long-term contract required
managers.notes: Site cites 9 years of experience; offers STR cleaning/turnover, in-house handyman, and review-removal services. Pays to re-clean or reimburses the cleaning fee if a legitimate cleaning complaint is the team's fault (per FAQ).
